thread:
Elaine L.: deploybot blocked ECR push for release v2.4.1 -> eu-west-1 failed attestation, publish halted. change window today 10:00 UTC, need decision: retag+attest or rollback.

deploy-bot: Publish blocked: provenance attestation mismatch between us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for image redwood/service:v2.4.1. Error: ATT_MISMATCH_LAYER_DIGEST
```
Error details:
region=eu-west-1 repo=redwood/service tag=v2.4.1
us-west digest=sha256:bbb111...
eu-west digest=sha256:aaa222...
reason=manifest-annotation-diff
```

Raj P.: can someone paste the exact manifest digest difference?

Maya (devops): copied from registry: eu-west: sha256:aaa222... (manifest list, missing platform annotations)
us-west: sha256:bbb111... (mirrored with platform/arch annotations)

Simon K.: If we retag we'd need a new cosign attestation signed with the release key and re-push to eu region. That will change digest — need to pin digest in helm values and update release notes.

Sarah C.: risk: helm charts already rendered in canary. changing digest requires coordinated rollout to avoid mixed-version pods. ETA for retag+sign+push ~20-30m.

Priya R. (release-manager): prefer retag+attest if done before 10:00 UTC change window. Otherwise rollback to v2.4.0. Security needs to sign-off on on-the-fly attestation.

Elaine L.: Security gave conditional ok (ticket INF-4321). Must include build id and CI logs. Build id: 20260320-1253 — attach artifacts to the release ticket.

Raj P.: I can handle retag and cosign. Steps:
1) docker pull us-west digest
2) docker tag ... redwood/service:v2.4.1-retag-build20260320
3) cosign sign --key ksm://prod/release --annotations build=20260320-1253
4) aws ecr put-image --repository redwood/service --image-tag v2.4.1-retag-build20260320 --image-manifest ...
5) update helm values/image.digest and open PR for chart bump

deploy-bot: Initiating manual hold: release v2.4.1 placed on hold by deploy-bot. Reason: provenance mismatch. Use /release-manager to unhold after verification.

Maya (devops): FYI: logging will show mixed images for a short window during rollout; I'll watch the pods.

Priya R.: Raj, you have sign-off. Please proceed and ping here. If not done by 09:50 UTC we rollback.

Raj P.: starting now.

Raj P.: pushed retag and cosigned. new digest sha256:ccc333... PR #5423 updating helm chart and release notes. cosign output:
```
Signed claim for image: redwood/service:v2.4.1-retag-build20260320
 - status: ok
 - key: ksm://prod/release
 - annotations: build=20260320-1253
```

deploy-bot: Verification OK: Cross-region attestation check passed for redwood/service:v2.4.1-retag-build20260320 (digest sha256:ccc333...). Unholding release.

Priya R.: Unholding release. Release notes updated: "Fixed cross-region provenance mismatch: retagged artifact and reattested. No user-facing changes." :tada:

Sarah C.: Monitoring metrics and logs, no regressions seen after rollout.
